28046-critical-and-historical-essays-vol.title: Critical And Historical Essays
28046-critical-and-historical-essays-vol.creator: Lord Macaulay
28046-critical-and-historical-essays-vol.description: A book by Lord Macaulay. remote from levity and bigotry, serious and earnest, yet tolerant and impartial. It is, therefore, with the greatest pleasure that we now see this book take its place among the English classics. Of the translation we need only say that it is such as might be expected from the skill, the taste, and the scrupulous integrity of the accomplished lady who, as an interpreter between the mind of Germany and the mind of Britain, has already deserved so well of both countries.

arxiv-2005-00260.title: Partial Univalence in n n -truncated Type Theory Conference: Proceedings of the 35th Annual ACM/IEEE Symposium on Logic in Computer Science (LICS); July 8–11, 2020; Saarbrücken, Germany Proceedings of the 35th Annual ACM/IEEE Symposium on Logic in Computer Science (LICS ’20), July 8–11, 2020, Saarbr
arxiv-2005-00260.creator: Christian Sattler, Andrea Vezzosi
arxiv-2005-00260.description: Abstract . It is well known that univalence is incompatible with uniqueness of identity proofs (UIP), the axiom that all types are h-sets. This is due to finite h-sets having non-trivial automorphisms as soon as they are not h-propositions. A natural question is then whether univalence restricted to h-propositions is compatible with UIP.

arxiv-2103-02320.title: Spatial entanglement engineering by pump shaping
arxiv-2103-02320.creator: Pauline Boucher 1 , Hugo Defienne 2 , and Sylvain Gigan 1,∗
arxiv-2103-02320.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pauline Boucher 1 , Hugo Defienne 2 , and Sylvain Gigan 1,∗. The ability to engineer the properties of quantum optical states is essential for quantum information processing applications. Here, we demonstrate tunable control of spatial correlations between photon pairs produced by spontaneous parametric down-conversion. By shaping the spatial pump beam profile in a type-I collinear configuration, we tailor the spatial structure of coincidences between photon pairs entangled in high dimensions, without effect on intensity.

arxiv-2105-05745.title: S. Acharya
arxiv-2105-05745.description: Abstract Measurements of event-by-event fluctuations of charged-particle multiplicities in Pb–Pb collisions at s NN \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}} = = 2.76 TeV using the ALICE detector at the CERN Large Hadron Collider (LHC) are presented in the pseudorapidity range | η | < 0.8 |\eta|<0.8 and transverse momentum 0.2 < p T < 2.0 0.2<p_{\rm T}<2.0 GeV/ c c .

arxiv-2108-06987.title: Uniformly accurate schemes for drift–oscillatory stochastic differential equations
arxiv-2108-06987.creator: Ibrahim Almuslimani a , ∗ \ast , Philippe Chartier b , Mohammed Lemou c and Florian Méhats d
arxiv-2108-06987.description: Abstract . In this work, we adapt the micro-macro methodology to stochastic differential equations for the purpose of numerically solving oscillatory evolution equations. The models we consider are addressed in a wide spectrum of regimes where oscillations may be slow or fast.

arxiv-2109-06546.title: Recursion relations for scattering amplitudes with massive particles II: massive vector bosons
arxiv-2109-06546.creator: Sourav Ballav, and Arkajyoti Manna
arxiv-2109-06546.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sourav Ballav, and Arkajyoti Manna. Using the recently introduced recursion relations with covariant massive-massless shift, we study tree-level scattering amplitudes involving a pair of massive vector bosons and an arbitrary number of gluons in the massive spinor-helicity formalism. In particular, we derive compact expressions for cases in which i) all gluons are of the same helicity and ii) one gluon has flipped helicity and is colour adjacent to one of the massive particles.

arxiv-2301-07169.title: On ring-like event systems in quantum logic
arxiv-2301-07169.creator: Dietmar Dorninger, Helmut Länger
arxiv-2301-07169.description: Abstract A class of ring-like event systems (RLSEs) is studied that generalizes Boolean rings. Quantum logics represented by orthomodular lattices are characterized within this class and the correspondence between Boolean algebras and Boolean rings is enlarged to orthomodular lattices. The structure of RLSEs and various subclasses is analysed and classical logics are especially identified.

arxiv-2301-13829.title: On the Deepest Cycle of a Random Mapping
arxiv-2301-13829.creator: Ljuben Mutafchiev, Steven Finch
arxiv-2301-13829.description: Abstract Let 𝒯 n \mathcal{T}_{n} be the set of all mappings T : { 1 , 2 , … , n } → { 1 , 2 , … , n } T:\{1,2,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,2,\ldots,n\} . The corresponding graph of T T is a union of disjoint connected unicyclic components.

arxiv-2312-02614.title: Prompt Optimization via Adversarial In-Context Learning
arxiv-2312-02614.creator: Xuan Long Do, Yiran Zhao, Hannah Brown, Yuxi Xie, James Xu Zhao, Nancy F. Chen, Kenji Kawaguchi, Michael Shieh, Junxian He
arxiv-2312-02614.description: Abstract We propose a new method, Adversarial In-Context Learning (adv-ICL 1 1 1 Our codes will available at https://github.com/zhaoyiran924/Adv-In-Context-Learning . ), to optimize prompts for in-context learning (ICL). Inspired by adversarial learning, adv-ICL is implemented as a two-player game between a generator and discriminator, with LLMs acting as both.

arxiv-2505-09891.title: Complex electronic topography and magnetotransport in an in-plane ferromagnetic kagome metal
arxiv-2505-09891.creator: Anup Pradhan Sakhya, Richa Pokharel Madhogaria, Barun Ghosh, Nabil Atlam, Milo Sprague, Mazharul Islam Mondal, Himanshu Sheokand, Arun K. Kumay, Shirin Mozaffari, Rui Xue, Yong P. Chen, David G. Mandrus, Arun Bansil, Madhab Neupane
arxiv-2505-09891.description: Abstract The intricate interplay between flat bands, Dirac cones, and magnetism in kagome materials has recently attracted significant attention from materials scientists, particularly in compounds belonging to the R Mn 6 Sn 6 family (R = Sc, Y, rare-earths), due to their inherent magnetic frustration.

arxiv-2509-21804.title: Towards reconstructing quantum structured light on a quantum computer
arxiv-2509-21804.creator: Mwezi Koni, Shawal Kasim, Paola C. Obando, Neelan Gounden, Isaac Nape
arxiv-2509-21804.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mwezi Koni, Shawal Kasim, Paola C. Obando, Neelan Gounden, Isaac Nape. We introduce a variational quantum computing approach for reconstructing quantum states from measurement data. By mapping the reconstruction cost function onto an Ising model, the problem can be solved using a variational eigensolver on present-day quantum hardware. As a proof of concept, we demonstrate the method on quantum structured light, in particular, entangled photons carrying orbital angular momentum and show that the reconstruction procedure can yield reliable performance even on noisy devices.

arxiv-2603-16270.creator: Kangxu Wang, Siang Chen, Chenxing Jiang, Shaojie Shen, Yixiang Dai, Guijin Wang

europmc-pmc7861483.description: In 2019, approximately 51 million U.S. adults aged ≥18 years reported any mental illness,* and 7.7% reported a past-year substance use disorder † (1). Although reported prevalence estimates of certain mental disorders, substance use, or substance use disorders are not generally...

pmc-10667714.title: Unprecedented synthesis of a 14-membered hexaazamacrocycle
pmc-10667714.creator: Anastasia A Fesenko, Anatoly D Shutalev, Bastien Nay
pmc-10667714.description: The transformation of 3-[(ethoxymethylene)amino]-1-methyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carbonitrile into the 14-membered macrocycle, 2,10-dimethyl-2,8,10,16-tetrahydrodipyrazolo[3,4-e:3',4'-l][1,2,4,8,9,11]hexaazacyclotetradecine-4,12-diamine, by the reaction with excess hydrazine under various conditions was studied in detail. The reaction proceeded through the initial formation of 4-imino-2-methyl-2,4-dihydro-5H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-5-amine followed by dimerization to give the final macrocycle. A convenient synthesis of the latter starting from 4-imino-2-methyl-2,4-dihydro-5H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-5-amine was developed. A plausible pathway for the macrocycle self-assembly is discussed.

pmc-11548652.title: Induced Electron Traps via the PCBM in P(VDF-HFP) Composites to Enhance Dielectric and Energy Storage Performance
pmc-11548652.creator: Yantao Yang, Jingqi Qiao, Haiyu Sun, Wenhao Yang, Liangliang Wei, Xuetong Zhao
pmc-11548652.description: Polymer-based composites with excellent dielectric properties are essential for advanced energy storage applications. In this work, the [6,6]-phenyl-C61-butyric acid methyl ester (PCBM) as a filler was incorporated into the poly(vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) (P(VDF-HFP)) composite to improve its dielectric performance. P(VDF-HFP) composite films with varying PCBM concentrations were prepared via solution casting and their dielectric, energy storage, and charge–discharge properties were characterized.

pmc-11861225.title: The factor structure the PHQ-9 in Russian patients recovered from COVID-19
pmc-11861225.creator: M. Zinchuk, G. Kustov, S. Popova, A. Razmakhnin, D. Zhuravlev, R. Akzhigitov, A. Guekht
pmc-11861225.description: IntroductionThe nine-item Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) is the first choice for screening for depression in primary care and other medical settings. The PHQ-9 has been shown to be a reliable and valid measure of depression symptoms, but there is disagreement among researchers about the factor structure of this questionnaire.

pmc-12608993.title: The Human Shield in Time but Not in Space: Scale-Dependent Responses of Small Indian Civet–Prey Interactions to Anthropogenic Disturbance
pmc-12608993.creator: Chengpeng Ji, Xiaochun Huang, Yufang Lin, Yanan Cheng, Tongchao Le, Fanglin Tan, Brian L Cypher
pmc-12608993.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryHuman activities are increasingly altering natural ecosystems, but their effects on predator–prey interactions are not fully understood. We used camera traps to study how human activity (human presence, roads, and settlements) as well as altitudes and seasons influence the spatiotemporal relationships between the small Indian civet and its potential prey (nocturnal rats, diurnal Pallas’s squirrels, and Chinese bamboo partridges) in southeastern China. Our results show that human disturbance caused both predators and prey to shift their daily activity patterns.

pmc-12979862.title: Amorphous/crystalline interwoven multipods with high Co/Ni activity for wide-temperature-range sodium-sulfur batteries
pmc-12979862.creator: Tingjiao Xiao, Zhen Fang, Nian Ran, Ronghui Liu, Yuxuan Gao, Jianbo Wu, Jianjun Liu, Hua Wang, Wen-Feng Lin, Wei Zhou
pmc-12979862.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Sluggish kinetics caused by 16-electron transfer hinders development of wide-temperature-range sodium-sulfur batteries. Here we report Sn-doped CoNiS multipods with an amorphous-crystalline interwoven structure. Employed as a positive electrode catalyst, the resulting sodium–sulfur battery exhibits a discharge capacity of 1320.8 mAh g−1 at 3 A g−1 after 1200 cycles at room temperature, together with stable and high-capacity electrochemical performance ranged from −20 to 50 °C.

pmc-12998856.title: Contemporary Chinese newspaper discourse on translation: A mixed-methods approach to the People’s Daily (1949–2023)
pmc-12998856.creator: Xinyu Shi, Libo Huang
pmc-12998856.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Newspaper discourse on translation forms a particular discourse that uses newspapers as a medium to discuss the products, processes, and functions of translation. It can reflect how a society perceives translation as a general phenomenon in a certain period. Adopting a mixed-methods approach to the contemporary Chinese newspaper discourse on translation, this study examines the perceived roles of translation in the People’s Daily between 1949 and 2023.

pmc-13061959.title: Engineering novel ceramic metal oxides with residual carbon for efficient sequestration of Auramine O from wastewater
pmc-13061959.creator: Reem M. Alghanmi, Ehab A. Abdelrahman
pmc-13061959.description: Auramine O is a hazardous cationic dye that threatens aquatic ecosystems by suppressing photosynthesis, and it poses health risks to humans through toxicity and bioaccumulation. Its chemical persistence allows it to remain in water bodies and enter food chains, which amplifies environmental and medical concerns.

pmc-13170055.title: Barn owls exert top‐down effects on the abundance and behavior of rodent pests
pmc-13170055.creator: Katherine C. Larson, Roger A. Baldwin, Matthew D. Johnson
pmc-13170055.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Predators can exert top‐down effects on their prey by direct consumption, by imposing risk of predation, or a combination of both. However, empirical evidence for these effects is mixed and inconsistent. Barn owls in agriculture present a system with attributes that should, according to theory, lead to strong top‐down effects, but research is limited and the distinction between effects on prey abundance and behavior remains unresolved.

pmc-13178424.title: A simple nomogram to help guide the diagnosis of cardiac amyloidosis in patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
pmc-13178424.creator: Qiao Yang, Rui Li, Hong Yang, Yujian Liu, Fuyang Liu, Jiangtao Yan, Rui Zeng, Chunrui Li, Hesong Zeng, Hong Wang
pmc-13178424.description: BackgroundCardiac amyloidosis (CA) has been recognized as a more frequent cause of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). However, missed and delayed diagnosis in CA by cardiologists are common. The study aimed to develop a simple nomogram to identify high risk of CA in HFpEF patients, warranting a further systematic diagnostic algorithm of CA.

pmc-13254881.title: From crisis to resilience: Catalysing epidemic and pandemic preparedness through National Public Health Institutes
pmc-13254881.creator: Thanitsara Rittiphairoj, Catherine Smallwood, Moa Herrgard, Wasiq Khan
pmc-13254881.description: The COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the critical role of National Public Health Institutes (NPHIs) in responding to global health emergencies. This commentary examined the contributions and challenges of NPHIs in four countries of the Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR), including Somalia, Morocco, Pakistan, and Jordan, during the pandemic response.

pmc-13265399.title: Development of a Brain‐Penetrant Nurr1 Agonist Tool
pmc-13265399.creator: Jan Vietor, Tanja Stiller, Christian Gege, Wael Saeb, Úrsula López‐García, Hella Kohlhof, Daniel Vitt, Daniel Merk
pmc-13265399.description: The ligand‐sensing transcription factor nuclear receptor‐related 1 (Nurr1), is thought to mediate neuroprotective activity and is implicated in various neurodegenerative diseases. Nurr1 ligands have been developed as tools to capture the receptor's potential in vitro and in vivo, but a dedicated brain‐targeting agonist has been lacking.

pmc-13408525.title: Pullulan-Based Gels with Food-Related Orientation: From Microbial Production to Synergistic Assemblies
pmc-13408525.creator: Maria Syrigou, Erminta Tsouko
pmc-13408525.description: Pullulan is a microbial exopolysaccharide produced primarily by Aureobasidium spp. It has attracted considerable attention due to its biodegradability, biocompatibility, and versatility in food-related applications. While its basic chemical structure has long been established, recent advances have significantly improved the understanding of the genetic, enzymatic, and regulatory mechanisms governing its biosynthesis.

pmc-13431657.creator: Christian Rosas-Salazar, Tebeb Gebretsadik, James D Chappell, R Stokes Peebles, William D Dupont, Meghan H Shilts, Samadhan J Jadhao, Larry J Anderson, Suman R Das, Tina V Hartert

pmc-13574363.creator: Meera Viswanathan, Jennifer Cook Middleton, Nila A. Sathe, Shivani Reddy, LaToshia Rouse, Jessica Vaughan, Shaunette Howard, Rachel Peragallo Urrutia
pmc-13574363.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Doula support may be associated with lower rates of preterm and cesarean birth; however, available studies have a high risk of bias and lead to very low to moderate certainty of evidence.

uslaw-usc-t15-s278e.title: 15 U.S.C. § 278e — Functions and activities
uslaw-usc-t15-s278e.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s278e.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 7 (National Institute Of Standards And Technology). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In the performance of the functions of the Institute the Secretary of Commerce is authorized to undertake the following activities: (a) The purchase, repair, and cleaning of uniforms for guards; (b) the care, maintenance, protection, repair, and alteration of Institute buildings.
